prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
competitors_mentioned: UV beds as well as spray tanning
answer_verbatim:
If you mean **spray tanning**, **Gorgeous GLO Beauty Bar** looks like a strong all-around pick: a current Charlotte salon ranking lists it at **4.9/5 from 100 reviews**, and it specializes in custom spray tans and color matching. Prices listed are roughly **$25–$60**, depending on the service. [Details and booking](https://gorgeousglobeautybar.com/)

For an **all-natural, vegan spray tan**, consider **Organic Bronze Bar SouthPark** at **2907 Providence Rd, Suite 102A**. [Salon details](https://organicbronzebar.com/southpark/)

If you’re looking for **UV beds as well as spray tanning**, **Dilworth Tanning Spa** may be a better fit; it offers both, though prices are described as higher. Ratings and availability can vary by location, so check recent reviews and call ahead. UV tanning carries skin-damage risks; spray tanning avoids UV exposure.
